question: How should Image Tools arrange its eight destinations on a phone?
big_picture: Eight destinations make the phone bottom bar clip every name, so this is a choice about how the app is organised. You decide which destinations stay closest while editing. Four tabs keep Home, Workspace, Library and Activity one tap away; menu only puts every destination two taps away and gives the image more room; keep leaves today’s clipped tabs in place. If you do not answer, the bar stays as it is today. After an answer, I change the phone layout and send you a capture.
reason: Editing places stay one tap away with readable names, and all eight destinations remain available.

options.label: Keep four readable tabs and put the other four destinations in the menu
Remove the bottom bar and put all eight destinations in the menu
Keep all eight tabs with their clipped names
